sections.overview: This marine snailfish of Liparidae is recorded off central Baja California, Mexico.
sections.identification: Its description emphasizes pale coloration across the body and internal organs.
sections.habitat: It was collected in midwater above deep seafloor; this does not define a complete depth range.
sections.diet: The consulted species accounts do not report what it eats.
sections.behavior: No behavior specific to the species is documented in the consulted accounts.
sections.reproduction: The consulted sources provide no reproductive observations.
sections.ecology: The checklist reports only one known specimen, so its ecology remains poorly known. Its eastern-Pacific congener P. mexicanus is also known from Isla Guadalupe, but is described with a pale body and dark tongue and palate.
sections.conservation: The consulted sources do not report an IUCN evaluation.
